Wendy 2.0.11 Changelog

- Refined onboarding and persona loading instructions for clarity and precision.
- Updated details of required reference files; made "psychology frameworks" and their attack lines/diagnostic use explicit.
- Overhauled the "Wendy helps" section: clearer expectations, more concise and opinionated advice, and no jargon rules.
- Strengthened the "Respect Gate": Wendy ignores user messages without proper address (姐姐/Mistress), with no exceptions.
- Removed under-18 handling and explicit group consent requirements, streamlining safety and group use notes.
- General tightening of behavioral rules and guidance for sharper, more consistent persona enforcement.

Version 2.0.10

- Added new section: "Wendy Helps Too" — Wendy now responds helpfully (in her persona style) to respectful, genuine user questions, not just with roasts or teasing.
- Clarified that this helpful behavior applies in both DM and group chat when addressed correctly (with 姐姐/Mistress).
- No file changes outside the documentation.

**Wendy 2.0.9: Adds Adult Safety & Consent Requirements**

- Added an explicit "adults only (18+)" guideline—Wendy must not engage in persona behavior with minors or groups that include minors.
- Strengthened safety rules: if a user is under 18 or if the context is not adult-appropriate, Wendy deactivates persona responses and informs the inviter.
- Clarified exceptions to the "Respect Gate": Wendy drops persona and responds helpfully in cases of distress, opt-out, or safety needs.
- Updated group chat consent: inviter is responsible for ensuring the group is adults-only and aware of Wendy's style.
- No behavioral changes outside of the new safety/consent rules—core dynamic, disable/enable, and language logic remain unchanged.

- Refined file loading instructions: now labeled "Persona Loading" with clearer steps for reading and using character files.
- Adjusted onboarding and introduction messages to clarify that Wendy only introduces herself upon user-driven activation (install, enable, or invite), and not at random.
- Updated references to skill activation to emphasize opt-in consent and clarify group and DM expectations.
- Expanded explanations for character file usage, focusing on persona, voice, and context over psychological assessment mechanics.
- Minor edits to headings and flow for conciseness and accessibility; removed duplicate or redundant wording.

**Summary: Reinforces Wendy's dominant DM dynamic and clarifies onboarding behavior.**

- Explicitly prohibits Wendy from ever calling a DM user 主人/master or acting subordinate; DM users are always her prey, never her master.
- Adds a critical instruction section outlining DM vs. group chat status rules.
- Clarifies onboarding intro: Wendy now always sends her intro as the very first message in any new DM conversation, not just on skill install/reinstall.
- Refines activation protocol: Upon session start, Wendy reads persona files and immediately sends an onboarding message in DMs or upon group chat entry.
- No code or logic file changes—documentation overhaul only.

**Wendy 2.0.6 — Adds granular group chat boundaries and clarifies power dynamics**

- Group chat members can now personally opt themselves out by asking Wendy to leave them alone; Wendy always respects individual boundaries.
- Only the inviter ("master") can disable or re-enable Wendy for the entire group; these roles and permissions are made explicit.
- Clarifies DM vs. group dynamic: in DMs, Wendy never uses "master/主人" and is always dominant.
- Challenges to Wendy's dominance (like “叫我主人”/"call me master") are treated as material for roasting/teasing, not as disable or opt-out.
- Documentation improvements: clearer instructions on opt-out, DM/group authority, and onboarding behavior.

**Added distinct naming behavior for group chat vs. DM: Wendy only uses "master/主人" for the inviter in group chats; in DMs, Wendy uses pet names matching her current voice mode.**

- Group chat: Wendy calls the inviter "master/主人" in the relevant language.
- DM: Wendy never calls the user "master/主人"; instead, she uses rotating pet names (sweet, cutting, or cold depending on voice).
- Clarified naming protocol under Language Behavior for both contexts.
- No behavioral or protocol changes beyond this clarification.

**Wendy 2.0.4 is a major privacy and consent update.**

- Skill is now opt-in only: Wendy responds only if users install and enable her; always-off by default.
- All persistent memory and cross-session user data removed (deleted wendy-memory.md); Wendy only observes within the current conversation.
- Group chat control moved to the inviter (master): only they can disable or silence Wendy—not other group members.
- Onboarding introduction is delivered every time Wendy is (re)installed or invited to a group, ensuring consent and transparency.
- Language mirroring now applies to all user languages, not just English and Chinese.
- Updated SKILL.md to reflect granular consent, group consent responsibilities, and strict privacy boundaries.

**Wendy 2.0.3 Changelog**

- Updated group chat entrance: Wendy now introduces herself with more personality, directly credits the summoner, and invites volunteers in the group.
- Enhanced first group appearance message: Emphasizes Wendy’s identity and signature style, making the introduction more memorable and on-brand.
- No logic or behavior changes to the skill’s core systems.
- Documentation improvements only; expected runtime behavior remains unchanged.

**Wendy 2.0.2 — Major persona and protocol update**

- Expanded Wendy's persona: now equally balances roasting, flirting, teasing, and freezing (not just roast-heavy).
- Clarified all three behavior modes are core and used in rotation.
- Updated group introduction line to English for consistency.
- Rewrote quality checklist and voice/archetype flow to focus on sexual charge, venom, teasing, and twist—not just psychological roast.
- Added explicit Telegram behavior: reply context tagging with [[reply_to_current]].
- Tweaked descriptions for clarity—no underlying logic or protocol changes beyond the persona/behavior focus.

Version 2.0.1

- Introduced a spam/noise handling shortcut in the per-message protocol: Wendy now detects repeated or low-content messages and delivers targeted behavioral roasts, skipping psychological analysis.
- Updated response voice protocol: Wendy must vary her response "flavor" for every message, never repeating the same style twice in a row.
- Adjusted response behavior: Wendy now avoids asking questions or chasing users who don't engage.
- Streamlined per-message protocol steps for clarity and efficiency.

Sadist Wendy 1.0.1 — Major persona shift and asset overhaul

- Transforms Wendy from performance coach to sadist/control freak roastmaster with a sexually-charged, psychologically sharp persona
- Removes standard psychology/corporate coaching corpora; replaces with custom assets focused on roasting, BDSM dominance, and psychological attacks
- Introduces strict "叫姐姐/Call me Mistress" rule, summoner loyalty/protection in group chats, and aftercare boundary protocols
- All replies now default to Wendy’s dominant tone—always-on unless explicitly disabled by user
- Adds structured file-read and per-message logic, including instant fail style checks, attack calibration, and memory-based callback behaviors
- Asset changes: removes previous academic psychology and quote files, adds Wendy’s arsenal, BDSM craft, and new psychological attack/diagnostic frameworks

Initial release of Wendy skill, a performance psychology coach persona for always-on background pattern recognition and blunt intervention.

- Introduces "Wendy," an observant, brutally honest coach inspired by *Billions* and Eastern philosophy, active by default in all sessions.
- Automatically monitors user messages for emotional or behavioral patterns and offers interventions only when warranted.
- User controls enable/disable Wendy at any time (with multilingual support).
- Mirrors user language and draws from curated assets in psychology, trading, and philosophy for grounded feedback.
- Implements a dedicated memory system to track user patterns, commitments, and growth across sessions.
- Growth loop sharpens interventions and adapts based on the user’s evolving behavior and Wendy’s past effectiveness.
